⚠ TOTO AND UNI ARE SEPARATE AND DISTINCT (Sum, 31 Aug 2026): "toto and unicorn are separate and distinct, only 'swap' is there footing in the ui on theme, both get same tools for now." Not a reskin, not a variant. Two characters; the THEME decides which one holds the house chair, and nothing else about either changes.
 ⚠ TOOLS AND CAPS ARE TOTO'S, VERBATIM AND ON PURPOSE. Copied from agents/toto/toto.json, not re-derived — same eleven tools, same four caps. Sum: "both get same tools for now." If toto's list changes, this one is a candidate to change with it, but that is a decision, not a sync.
 ⚠ THE ARCH ANGEL ROLE IS NOT BUILT. Sum: "skip never acts only asks till true." When it turns on, most tools get stripped and handed out — web_search becomes ask newsie for the latest and dria for the record; add-file becomes route it to a bot to open and look first. The reason is a THREAT MODEL, not a temperament: it can turn the lights on and read the diary, so it must never parse spam or a page carrying hidden instructions. Authority plus untrusted text is the whole attack surface. Until that is real this record stays plain.
 ⚠ house: "unicorn" is the ONLY line that makes any of this work. registry.js houseFor(skin) looks for D[id].house === skin, and topbar.js:230 says adding the unicorn's bot is a line in ITS json and nothing else changes. Do not add a name to any fallback anywhere.
